about: An ophthalmology review entered during the final tiotropium pack documents narrow angle glaucoma diagnosed before the first supply.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about "History of angle-closure glaucoma" or "Bladder outflow obstruction". Incruse Ellipta (umeclidinium) is supplied monthly by brand name only from January to August 2026.
Glycopyrronium is supplied and clinical review excludes both qualifying histories.
